Although there was no hive present, it still was a considerable threat to Fuso, therefore an Army-Navy Joint Fighter Wing of various Fuso Witches, as well as a naval fleet, was dispatched to counter it.

entries.name: Neuroi
entries.content:
'Neuroi', also known as 'Kaii', are mysterious interdimensional alien-like beings that take the shape of strange machines and foreign aircrafts, and have also been known to mimic objects, buildings, and even take on human-like forms in a few occasions.

In ancient times; Neuroi used to take on the forms of various mythical beasts, dragons, demons, and yokai.

The structure of a modern Neuroi is composed of an external black and red armored shell with hexagon patterns, and a glowing red core is hidden inside the center of each; the only way to destroy a Neuroi is to penetrate their regenerative armor and destroy their core.

Neuroi are the main enemies of Humanity, they are completely hostile to almost all forms of life, often will attack anyone on sight, and have caused mass destruction wherever they've went.

Neuroi can travel by air or by land or sometimes underground, but they cannot migrate across large bodies of water because they use earthly resources and metals as sustenance; land-type Neuroi may not be frequent around coastal/island regions, although aerial-type may frequent both coastal/island regions and inland regions.

Humanity is currently at war with the Neuroi, known as the 'Second Neuroi War', but despite this threat being on Earth for over hundreds of years the main cause of their origin is still unknown.

entries.name: X-11 Witch-Type Neuroi
entries.content: Some Neuroi have taken forms resembling Witches, and are commonly known as witch-type Neuroi or witch mimics. They attempt to mimic actual witches, though they lack the experience and teamwork capabilities of real witches. The most recent appearances of witch-like Neuroi would be the x-11 Neuroi that appeared over the Britannia Channel or the one that appeared near Venezia.

entries.name: Neuroi Cores, Hives, & Nests
entries.content: The core seems to be the most important part of the Neuroi and also their weak point. It is the source of both their offensive powers and regenerative abilities. The core tends to be the most heavily protected part as destroying it is the only way to actually defeat medium and large sized Neuroi. Neuroi hives are the primary base of operations and are capable of generating other aerial Neuroi. They can appear out of nowhere and take the shape of conical black funnel clouds made of toxic miasma. Ground bound hives are called nests instead, and serve as spawning points for land-based Neuroi.

entries.name: Neuroi Combat & Miasma
entries.content: In combat Neuroi use mainly energy beam weapons capable of vaporizing anything they hit. Smaller Neuroi usually fulfill escort and fighter roles. On the other hand, larger sized and capital type Neuroi might have more specialized roles and unique abilities or tactics in order to be harder to counter. Neuroi are also known to be able to release and spread toxic miasma dangerous to regular humans. Usually the miasma is just deployed as means to exercise control over specific areas, but some Neuroi are able to use it im battle and combat situations.

entries.name: Neuroification
entries.content: Neuroification is the process of transforming a machine into neuroi-like by using a Neuroi core as it's power source to enhance their weapons and combat capabilities. Two cases of it are currently known, being the incident with the Warlock in Gallian airspace, and the Neuroification of the Yamato to combat the Neuroi Hive in Venezia.
